template:
/*
CBP code-only template for the Branding Profile Specimen preview.
Use these references directly in Typst. Examples: #profile.profile_name, #specimen.page.size

Profile fields:
- profile.name: CBP document name.
- profile.profile_name: Display name.
- profile.company: Company linked to the profile.
- profile.is_default: True when default for company.
- profile.code_only: True when Code Only is enabled.

Page settings:
- specimen.page.size: Page size, e.g. A4.
- specimen.page.orientation: portrait or landscape.
- specimen.page.margin_top_mm, margin_right_mm, margin_bottom_mm, margin_left_mm: Margins in mm.

Typography settings:
- specimen.typography.section_label.family, size_pt, style, weight, color.
- specimen.typography.field_label.family, size_pt, style, weight, color.
- specimen.typography.field_value.family, size_pt, style, weight, color.
- specimen.typography.table_header.family, size_pt, style, weight, color.
- specimen.typography.table_body.family, size_pt, style, weight, color.

Table settings:
- specimen.table.inset_top_pt, inset_right_pt, inset_bottom_pt, inset_left_pt: Cell inset in pt.
- specimen.table.border_width_pt: Table border stroke in pt.
- specimen.table.border_color: Table border color.
- specimen.table.header_fill: Header background color.
- specimen.table.striping_enabled: True when alternating rows are enabled.
- specimen.table.stripe_fill: Alternating row color.
- specimen.table.rows: Array of sample rows. Use specimen.table.rows.map(row => (...)).

Sample table row fields:
- row.label: Label text.
- row.value: Rendered value text.
- row.amount: Numeric sample text.
- row.status: Status text.

Branding settings:
- specimen.branding.mode: Branding mode.
- specimen.branding.logo_source: Company logo or Upload image.
- specimen.branding.logo_width_mm: Logo width in mm.
- specimen.branding.logo_offset_x_mm, logo_offset_y_mm: Logo position from the page border in mm.
- specimen.branding.letterhead_source: Use System Letterhead or Upload Letterhead.
- specimen.branding.letterhead: Selected letterhead or uploaded file URL.

QR settings:
- specimen.qr.enabled: True when QR is enabled.
- specimen.qr.size_mm: QR size in mm.
- specimen.qr.dx_mm, dy_mm: QR position from the page border in mm.
*/

#set text(font: "Inter 18pt", size: 9pt)

#let sample-heading = (size: 9pt, weight: "bold", fill: rgb("#334155"))

#text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold")[Page Settings]
#grid(
  columns: (1fr,) * 4,
  gutter: 12pt,
  [Profile\n#profile.profile_name],
  [Company\n#profile.company],
  [Size\n#specimen.page.size],
  [Orientation\n#specimen.page.orientation],
)

#v(1em)
#text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold")[Typography Settings]
#grid(
  columns: (1fr,) * 3,
  gutter: 14pt,
  [#text(..sample-heading)[Section Label]\n#text(size: specimen.typography.section_label.size_pt * 1pt, fill: rgb(specimen.typography.section_label.color), weight: "bold")[Section Label]],
  [#text(..sample-heading)[Field Label]\n#text(size: specimen.typography.field_label.size_pt * 1pt, fill: rgb(specimen.typography.field_label.color), weight: "semibold")[Field Label]],
  [#text(..sample-heading)[Field Value]\n#text(size: specimen.typography.field_value.size_pt * 1pt, fill: rgb(specimen.typography.field_value.color))[Field Value]],
)

#v(1em)
#text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold")[Table Settings]
#table(
  columns: (1fr, 1.5fr, auto, auto),
  inset: specimen.table.inset_top_pt * 1pt,
  stroke: (paint: rgb(specimen.table.border_color), thickness: specimen.table.border_width_pt * 1pt),
  table.header([Column 1], [Column 2], [Column 3], [Column 4]),
  ..specimen.table.rows.map(row => (
    [#row.label],
    [#row.value],
    [#row.amount],
    [#row.status],
  )).flatten(),
)

#v(1em)
#text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold")[Branding]
#grid(
  columns: (1fr,) * 4,
  gutter: 12pt,
  [Mode\n#specimen.branding.mode],
  [Logo source\n#specimen.branding.logo_source],
  [Logo width\n#specimen.branding.logo_width_mm mm],
  [Letterhead\n#specimen.branding.letterhead],
)

#v(1em)
#text(size: 13pt, weight: "bold")[QR Code]
#grid(
  columns: (1fr,) * 4,
  gutter: 12pt,
  [Enabled\n#specimen.qr.enabled],
  [Size\n#specimen.qr.size_mm mm],
  [X\n#specimen.qr.dx_mm mm],
  [Y\n#specimen.qr.dy_mm mm],
)
